rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE PARTICIPATION OF CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANIZATIONS IN THE ANNUAL NATIONAL BUDGET PROCESS AND PROVIDING EFFECTIVE MECHANISMS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Defines CSO as a non-government organization (NGO), cause-oriented group, people's organization, cooperative, trade union, professional association, faith-based organization, media group, indigenous people's movement, which monitors, government projects, engages in policy discussions, and actively participates in collaborative activities with the government.
Intends to institutionalize people's involvement in budget discussions at all levels of government and provides full play to the people's right to participate in all levels of social, political, and economic decision-making without undermining the capacities of elected representatives in creating a budget that is needed by a particular locality

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF TAX RACKETEERING, ADDING FOR THE PURPOSE A SECTION 157-A TO THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the issue regarding the evasion of taxes by corporations using fictitious sales invoices or receipts involving false and anomalous purchases - called "ghost receipts" or the practice of "ghosting the tax authority."

Proposes to define the offense of tax racketeering as "any coordinated scheme or operation to repeatedly or consistently evade or defeat any tax imposed under the National Internal Revenue Code through fraudulent use of receipts, returns, and other records, with minimum amount of Ten Million (P10,000,000.00) in taxes avoided or attempted to be avoided".
rows.status: Substituted by HB08144

rows.author: F057;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 52 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8435 OR THE AGRICULTURE AND FISHERIES MODERNIZATION ACT OF 1997
rows.abstract:
Amends Section 52 of Republic Act No. 8435 as follows:
"Section 52. Farm-to-Market Roads
The Department shall coordinate with the LGUs with its resident farmers and fisherfolk to identify priority locations . . .
Construction of farm-to-market roads shall be a priority [investment] of the LGUs.  [which shall provide a counterpart of not less than ten percent (10%) of the project cost subject to their IRA level.]"
Proposes not to require LGUs to use their IRA for FMR's construction since some LGUs solely rely on IRA for their revenue.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE INSTITUTE FOR STRATEGIC STUDIES AND FOR OTHER
PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to address urgent scientific and continuing policy research and strategic studies as bases in dealing with our fundamental and critical international and national concerns like significant technical advances in communications, information, and transportation; large-scale military confrontation; competition for resources; outstanding territorial conflicts; continuing insurgency; and local communist movement.
Provides that strategic studies by a group of selected scholar-members shall conduct strategic research on national and international concerns, formulate various policy options on various national issues, and 3) recommend appropriate actions to support such policies and strategies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 2023-03-21

rows.author: F057;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING FOREIGN PROGRAMMING THROUGH THE GRANTING OF LANDING RIGHTS, DESIGNATING THE NATIONAL TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMMISSION AS THE APPROPRIATE REGULATORY BODY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Defines several terms such as Cable TV Operator, Foreign Program/Programmer, and Landing Right, etc.
Landing Right - the right to transmit in/into the territory of the Philippines a particular foreign program/foreign channel, granted to the programmer from whom it originates after the said programmer's proper application is duly filed with and approved by the Commission.
Proposes that NTC shall be vested with jurisdiction over and regulation of all foreign programs, including the power to grant, renew and revoke Landing Rights; and the authority to resolve all disputes between foreign programmers and cable TV operators.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2023-03-21

rows.author: F057;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLICATION OF ANY FOREIGN AID AGREEMENT WITHIN ONE MONTH AFTER THE SIGNING THEREOF IN TWO NATIONAL NEWSPAPERS OF GENERAL CIRCULATION
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the following issues:  the country's development is still lagging behind those of many other nations in Southeast Asia despite its being a perennial recipient of foreign assistance; the perceived one among the primary causes of the wastage in foreign aid is the lack of transparency in its disclosures and the supposed beneficiary of the same; and the "disturbing" capacity of the country to meet commitments based on the Paris Declaration on Aid Effectiveness of 2010.
Proposes that the publication shall include the agreement itself, the country or organization which is the source of the foreign aid, the amount involved, the beneficiaries thereof, the project or program covered, and the conditional ties attached thereat.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 2023-03-21
